title: Yama Kinkara
desc: Yama, the Lord of death, sends his assistant to earth to reap the life of a beautiful girl. Instead, smitten with her beauty, he falls in love and decides to prevent her death.

title: Rajadhani
desc: Five friends believe that money can buy anything in the world and wish to get rich quickly. When they choose a crooked way to earn riches, they become entangled in a web of crime.

title: Mana Shankara Vara Prasad Garu
desc: A former law enforcement officer, now working in security, is tasked with safeguarding his alienated spouse and children from a vindictive ex-police officer.

title: Dude
desc: Agan and Kural, lifelong friends, face a turning point when the latter suffers a heartbreak. Subsequently, Agan must decide whether to confess his secret love or keep his feelings hidden.

title: Hey Balwanth
desc: Krishna learns that his father's inn is a cover for a brothel, and keeps it secret from Mithra, a girl he loves. However, her grandfather's death causes chaos and unveils the secret.

title: Mugilpete
desc: Raja and Apoorva fall head-over-heels for one another, but must overcome their families' opposing views on love. Things come to a head when Apoorva goes missing and Raja sets out to track her down.
